semiconductor_relevance: High — Alinc Taiwan specializes in laser processing equipment and contract manufacturing services for MEMS, which are critical in semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Alinc Taiwan Co., Ltd. provides advanced laser processing equipment and related services, acting as an exclusive agent for products developed by the Japan Atomic Energy Research Institute. The company focuses on solutions for mass production of Co-Packaged Optics and offers consulting and contract manufacturing services for micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS).
capabilities: Laser processing equipment for semiconductor applications
Contract manufacturing for MEMS using laser technology
High-precision glass components for optical applications

regional_presence.Taiwan: Alinc Taiwan was established in 2005 and operates within the region, focusing on advanced manufacturing solutions.
